_source: Per-player two-way overrides, keyed "first last|draft year" (lower-case, letters only). An entry wins in any era: `roles` (Madden labels: K P FS SS CB WR TE HB FB QB C LG LT DT LEDG REDG MIKE SAM WILL) replace what the career totals would infer; an empty list pins "no secondary role"; `era: false` switches off the single-platoon mirror (through 1949). Without an entry: 1980+ uses nflverse draft_picks career totals (30+ receptions for a non-receiver, 3+ interceptions for an offensive player, 100+ carries for a non-back; a few snaps never qualify, and an undrafted player never matches a drafted namesake); before 1980 there are no totals, so only the entries here and the era rule apply. Kicking and punting are never in any table — always curated.

sammy baugh|1937.note: Led the NFL in passing, punting (51.4 yd avg, 1940) and interceptions (11, 1943)

sid luckman|1939.note: Chicago's punter and a defensive back in the single-platoon years

bill dudley|1942.note: 1946 MVP: led the league in rushing, interceptions and punt returns; kicked

bob waterfield|1944.note: Rams QB who kicked (field goals and extra points) and punted; 20 career interceptions

charley trippi|1945.note: Halfback, quarterback, punter and defensive back for the Cardinals

doak walker|1949.note: Led the NFL in scoring as a kicker-halfback; punted; played safety

george blanda|1949.note: Kicked for 26 seasons; still the career-scoring leader of his era

chuck bednarik|1949.note: The last full-time two-way player: center and linebacker into 1962

leo nomellini|1950.note: All-Pro at both defensive tackle and offensive tackle

lou groza|1946.note: Browns left tackle and the place-kicker who gave the position its name

frank gifford|1952.note: Started at defensive back in 1953 before moving to offense full time

les richter|1952.note: Rams linebacker who handled kickoffs and field goals

paul hornung|1957.note: Packers halfback and place-kicker; 1960 scoring record (176) with his foot

gino cappelletti|1960.note: Patriots receiver and kicker; AFL's all-time scorer

roy green|1979.note: Two-way in 1981 (33 catches for 708 yards as a part-time receiver while starting at cornerback); 4 career interceptions

jj watt|2011.note: Three catches at tight end are a package, not a role
